**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

Section 22 is the sole audit right binding us — I confirmed §23 ("Records and Customer Assurance") carries only a heading with no operative text, and searches for inspection/verification/records surfaced no other Customer-facing audit mechanic.

Every preferred element is already satisfied on the face of the clause:
- once in any twelve-month period; thirty days' prior written notice; normal business hours (22.1)
- off-site where practicable; independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1)
- Vendor bears costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent (22.2)
- no direct access to Customer systems, plus additional bars on unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, and third-party confidential information (22.2)

Section 22.3 adds protections in our favour (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, shortfall payment resolves the issue). No redline proposed.
